name: bento-ya
shortDescription: Tauri desktop app for orchestrating AI coding agents — a kanban board where columns are pipeline stages with trigger-driven automation.
description:
bento-ya is a Tauri desktop application for orchestrating AI coding agents through a kanban-style board. Each column is a pipeline stage with optional on_entry / on_exit triggers — describe the automation in natural language and the app generates the trigger config, or drop into an advanced editor for actions like spawn_cli, move_column, run_script, and create_pr.

Highlights:
- Per-task agent panel with embedded tmux-backed terminal, semantic transcript, lifecycle controls (Hold / Stop / Kill), and live model + thinking-effort selectors.
- v2.0 adds GitHub PR auto-create on column exit, per-task git worktree isolation, and a DAG dependency UI with hover-reveal bezier lines and cycle detection.
- v2.1 adds full per-task xterm.js terminals — WebGL renderer, 10k-line scrollback, Unicode 11, theme-reactive, lazy PTY sessions spawned on panel open.
